name: Docker Cloud Sandboxes

modes.label: Pay-as-you-go fixed sizes (micro..xl), per second
modes.note: Linear $0.07 per (1 vCPU + 2 GiB)-hour, metered per second while running (allocation, not utilisation). Stopped sandboxes (memory + filesystem preserved) pay no compute. TTL default 1 h, extendable to max 24 h from creation; default on-timeout = stop if resumable else delete. amd64 or arm64 'subject to account availability'.

plans.name: Docker Agentic Platform (pay-as-you-go)
plans.note: No recurring fee; billed monthly in arrears on a personal Docker account, separate from any Docker Personal/Pro/Team/Business subscription (which is not needed and not credited). Default quotas: 10 concurrent, 50 stored sandboxes, 100 volumes. Quota increases: process/price unpublished.

plans.name: AI Governance (org policy add-on)
plans.note: Organization-level sandbox policy governance, 'available on a separate paid subscription' (contact sales). Not a compute plan.

extras.price: BYO key, billed by your model provider (not by Docker; credits don't cover it)

extras.item: Local Docker Sandboxes (sbx on your laptop)
extras.price: Free, incl. commercial use; no Docker Desktop licence required

perf_source: No benchmark row: provider is not in ComputeSDK results or the HPC run (as of 2026-09-28). See research/perf-map.json.

knobs.label: Billed time per session vs useful time (sandboxes left to hit their TTL instead of being stopped)
knobs.why: Compute bills per second until the sandbox is stopped; the default TTL is 1 h, so an agent that finishes in 20 min but never stops keeps billing until expiry. Factor values are illustrative, not published.

caveats: Launched 2026-09-24; only one published rate card. Enterprise/volume pricing not published.
Default quota 10 concurrent sandboxes; higher concurrency process and cost unpublished (worked example of 50 concurrent needs a quota raise).
Hard cap 24 h from creation per sandbox (renew-timeout cannot go beyond); long jobs must be stopped/restarted or recreated.

Disk size per size tier not published (disk_gib null). Volumes are experimental and free; stopped-sandbox state storage free per 'Volumes, egress ... are free' and 'compute isn't billed while stopped'.
'Always-on' sandbox configuration appears in quota docs but has no separate price; assumed same per-second rate.
$250 one-time credit is a limited-time promo for new accounts; expiry unpublished. Credits don't cover model-provider charges.
Isolation: product page says MicroVM; hypervisor unnamed. Region(s) unpublished (regions []).
Docker Pro/Team/Business subscription fees are separate and not needed; they do not include cloud sandbox credit.

fleet.tiers: Default 10 concurrent, 50 stored; per-account overrides may differ.
fleet.notes: Official API limits give default 10 concurrent, 50 stored sandboxes; stopped releases concurrency unless always-on, but retains stored count. Docs warn accounts can differ and instruct confirmation with Docker before capacity-dependent work. No explicit numeric higher tier or quota-increase procedure/turnaround found.
